reckon/crew/routing.py:2360 _give_worktree_minimal_stat is called from _create_worktree on every successful creation
reckon/crew.py:87 _create_worktree is re-exported as the crew module's seam over routing

findings.text: non-blocking: the bounded wait-out of a held git lock in this loop duplicates the capability reckon/crew/merge.py:658 `_run_waiting_out_a_held_index_lock` already owns — bounded attempts, a lock-presence test and an on_retry hook — and is written here with its own deadline constants (_WORKTREE_CONFIG_LOCK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS/_POLL at :2367-2368) and its own refusal wording, so the repository now holds a second policy for "wait out a git lock, then refuse" that can drift from the first; generalising that helper to take the lock path would have kept one.

non-blocking: the retry fires on the prose "could not lock config file" in git's stderr while `_shared_config_lock` at :2390 has already resolved the lock path this function names in its refusal, so a git whose wording changes silently disables the retry and turns momentary contention back into the outright refusal this node exists to remove; merge.py:658 tests the lock file's presence rather than the message for exactly that reason.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against bf5030f: f782679b0d adds _shared_worktree_config_enabled, _shared_config_lock and _enable_shared_worktree_config and rewrites _give_worktree_minimal_stat (+72/-18) in reckon/crew/routing.py, 4e51a70c77 adds the 60-line evidence fragment, and the new test file's 180 lines add the four arms, all of it inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_a_worktree_leaves_the_shared_config_alone.py and four behaviours; the manifest's after_suite records 55 passed at f782679b0d ending EXIT=0 and baseline_suite records 4 failed, 51 passed at bf5030f ending EXIT=1 whose first failure at base-arm.log:65 is the recorded lock refusal, negative-control.log ends EXIT=1 at 2 failed, 2 passed, and I re-measured the ruff clause at head: 8 findings on routing.py against 9 at the base revision, and the new test file clean under both ruff check and ruff format.
item_verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that creating a worktree leaves the shared checkout's configuration alone when extensions.worktreeConfig already reads true, waits out a held configuration lock for a bounded time before refusing, and still sets the worktree's own core.checkStat=minimal; reckon/crew/routing.py:2404 `_enable_shared_worktree_config` reads the setting with `git config --bool --get` and returns before any write, :2421-2438 retries and then names the lock, and :2441-2456 preserves the worktree write.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it is complete, names commits f782679b0d and 4e51a70c77, lists changed_paths matching the diff, and carries armed baseline_suite and after_suite JSON with completed true and log paths that exist; its after_suite names after-arm.log while the --basetemp run it also depends on is after-arm-basetemp.log, both green at 55 passed.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The fence grants reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_a_worktree_leaves_the_shared_config_alone.py, docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/worktree-leaves-shared-config.html and a figures directory; the two commits change exactly the first three files and write no figure.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_worktree_leaves_the_shared_config_alone.py:118-136 fails if the shared configuration is rewritten while it already reads true, and negative-control.log shows exactly that failure with the unconditional write restored (2 failed, 2 passed, EXIT=1); every added assertion compares a value read back from git or the filesystem, never a value the test itself supplied.
justifications.evidence: base-arm.log:65 quotes the recorded refusal `error: could not lock config file .git/config: File exists` at bf5030f and after-arm-basetemp.log ends `55 passed` with `EXIT=0` at f782679b0d, so both armed JSON blocks the manifest records are backed by logs on disk; the partition claim (all_debug) rests on the manifest's word, since the arm logs' headers name tree and cwd rather than a job id.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/routing.py:2362-2438 follows the module's private-constant plus docstring-stating-the-mechanism idiom, and its symbols (_shared_worktree_config_enabled, _shared_config_lock, _enable_shared_worktree_config) name what they do with no plan, ticket or stage label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/routing.py:2404 returns without any write when the setting already reads true, :2421-2438 waits the lock out for a bound and then names it, and :2441-2456 still sets the worktree's own core.checkStat=minimal, which is the whole delivered goal.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/routing.py:2422 re-implements the bounded lock-wait reckon/crew/merge.py:658 `_run_waiting_out_a_held_index_lock` already owns rather than extending it with a lock-path parameter, so the wait is written twice in one package.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff bf5030fbe80d 4e51a70c77d9 changes only reckon/crew/routing.py, tests/test_a_worktree_leaves_the_shared_config_alone.py and docs/evidence/fragments/work-flows-to-the-lane/worktree-leaves-shared-config.html, all three inside the fence's declared paths, and no figure was written.
